simple.meaning: מִשְׁעֵן (mishʻên) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a support (concretely), i.e. (figuratively) a protector or sustenance.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Samuel 22:19. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִשְׁעֵן (H4937) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מִשְׁעֵן (mishʻên) / H4937 is traced through 2 Samuel 22:19, Psalms 18:19, Isaiah 3:1 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: a support (concretely), i.e. (figuratively) a protector or sustenance
